issues.display_title: Issue #598: Centralize GoThru Integration Error Handling, Keycloak Linkage, and Redis Caching
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Centralize GoThru Integration Error Handling, Keycloak Linkage, and Redis Caching

  • Date: 21-10-2026
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS

1. Summary

Eliminated ~220+ lines of duplicate error handling, Keycloak link resolution, and Redis cache management boilerplate across all four GoThru integration endpoints in panorra-api-go:

  1. Shared Helpers Architecture (src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers.go):

    • HandleKeycloakLink: Safely resolves the user's Keycloak UUID, returning unlinked HTTP 200 responses with the provided empty data payload or HTTP 500 on database failure.
    • HandleGoThruError: Centralizes error handling by catching Keycloak authentication outages (HTTP 502), retrieving stale cache (24h) during provider downtime, mapping specific GoThru.ProviderError codes (404 Not Found, 401/403 to 502, 400 Bad Request), and falling back to HTTP 502.
    • GetCachedResponse & SetCachedResponse: Centralizes safe Redis cache inspection, JSON serialization, and dual-tier TTL management (60s active + 24h stale).

  2. Refactored Endpoints:

    • GetVirtualTours.go: Reduced boilerplate by ~66 lines.
    • GetTourPanoramas.go: Reduced boilerplate by ~71 lines.
    • GetVirtualTourDetail.go: Reduced boilerplate by ~71 lines.
    • GetTourLinks.go: Reduced boilerplate by ~71 lines.
    • Cleaned up unused imports across all 4 files.

  3. Automated Unit Testing (src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers_test.go):

    • Added unit tests for HandleKeycloakLink, Keycloak outage detection, provider 404/400/502 mapping, and nil-safe Redis cache access.

2. Files Updated & Created

  • Created: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers.go
  • Created: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers_test.go
  • Created: docs/tasks/21-10-2026/centralize_gothru_integration_error_and_cache_handling.md

  • Updated: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours.go
  • Updated: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go
  • Updated: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTourDetail.go
  • Updated: src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourLinks.go

3. Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/...
# PASS (0 issues)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/...
# PASS: 22/22 unit tests pass cleanly (100% OK)

  • Build Check:

    go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: GoThru Integration / Resilience / Clean Architecture / Code Deduplication
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers.go
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers_test.go
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTours.go
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourPanoramas.go
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetVirtualTourDetail.go
    • src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/GetTourLinks.go
  • Date: 21-10-2026

1. Problem & Context

Across all four GoThru integration endpoints in panorra-api-go:

  1. GET /gothru/virtual-tours (GetVirtualTours.go)
  2. GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/panoramas (GetTourPanoramas.go)
  3. GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key (GetVirtualTourDetail.go)
  4. GET /gothru/virtual-tours/:tour_key/links (GetTourLinks.go)

Each file contained ~60 lines of repeated boilerplate:

  • Keycloak Account Linkage: Looking up ResolveKeycloakSub(userId) and returning HTTP 200 with linked: false or HTTP 500 on database failure was repeated 4 times.
  • Provider Error & Outage Handling: Checking for Keycloak service unavailability (502 Bad Gateway), attempting fallback to Redis stale cache (24h) during outages, mapping GoThru.ProviderError (404 Not Found, 401/403 to 502, 400 Bad Request), and returning fallback 502 Bad Gateway was copied verbatim across all 4 files.
  • Cache Get/Set Plumbing: Manual JSON marshaling/unmarshaling and Redis client nil-checks were repeated for both the primary 60s cache and 24h stale cache.

This redundancy created high maintenance overhead and divergence risk whenever outage resilience policies are updated.

2. Scope

  1. Centralize Shared Helpers (src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers.go):

    • HandleKeycloakLink: Encapsulates user Keycloak sub lookup, returning unlinked 200 responses or 500 errors.
    • HandleGoThruError: Handles Keycloak outage fast-fail, stale cache fallback, provider error code mapping, and generic 502 fallback.
    • GetCachedResponse: Safe retrieval and JSON unmarshaling of cached responses from Redis.
    • SetCachedResponse: Safe JSON marshaling and setting of primary TTL and 24-hour stale cache entries.

  2. Refactor All 4 Endpoints:

    • Streamline GetVirtualTours.go, GetTourPanoramas.go, GetVirtualTourDetail.go, and GetTourLinks.go to delegate error and cache handling to shared helpers.
    • Remove unused imports (errors, github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2/log, panorra-api-go/src/Utils/Redis, gorm.io/gorm).

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Add unit test suite in src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/helpers_test.go covering unlinked user handling, Keycloak outage detection, provider status code mapping, and safe Redis cache behavior when Redis is uninitialized.

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Route paths, URL parameters, query parameters, HTTP status codes, and JSON response bodies remain identical.
    • Stale cache recovery during outages and Keycloak outage fail-fast behaviors function identically.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • ~220+ lines of duplicate boilerplate eliminated across the 4 endpoints.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Action/V1/GoThruIntegration/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./cmd/...).

issues.display_title: Issue #599: Eliminate AuthMiddleware Data Race and Harden JWT Verification
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Eliminate AuthMiddleware Data Race and Harden JWT Verification

  • Date: 21-10-2026
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS

1. Summary

Fortified authentication security, eliminated a concurrent data race, and protected against panic crashes across the authentication pipeline in panorra-api-go:

  1. Concurrency Data Race Elimination (src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware.go):

    • Removed var AuthData any and the concurrent write AuthData = data.
    • Replaced chained interface type assertions with safe two-step map validations.
    • Added c.Locals("keycloak", kc) propagation.

  2. JWT Algorithm Hardening (src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt.go):

    • Added token.Method.(*jwt.SigningMethodHMAC) validation in the keyfunc callback, returning a descriptive error on unexpected signing algorithms.

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt_test.go: Tests valid token verification, wrong secret rejection, and rejection of jwt.SigningMethodNone.
    • src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware_test.go: Expanded from 1 test to 8 tests covering path exclusions, missing headers, ignored routes, invalid tokens, valid users, malformed claims panic protection, and viewer role generation.

2. Files Updated & Created

  • Updated: src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware.go
  • Updated: src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware_test.go
  • Updated: src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt.go
  • Created: src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt_test.go
  • Created: docs/tasks/21-10-2026/eliminate_auth_middleware_data_race_and_harden_jwt.md
  • Created: docs/tasks/implementations/21-10-2026/eliminate_auth_middleware_data_race_and_harden_jwt_impl.md

3. Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/... ./src/Utils/Jwt/...
# PASS (0 issues)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/... ./src/Utils/Jwt/...
# PASS: 100% test suites pass cleanly

  • Build Check:

    go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Security / Concurrency / Authentication / Middleware
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware.go
    • src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware_test.go
    • src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt.go
    • src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt_test.go
  • Date: 21-10-2026

1. Problem & Context

  1. Package-Level Data Race:
    • src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware.go declared a package-level global variable var AuthData any that was overwritten on every incoming HTTP request (AuthData = data). Under concurrent client traffic, this caused a critical data race between goroutines, while AuthData was not even read or used anywhere in the codebase.
  2. Panic on Malformed JWT Claims:
    • Chained interface type assertion data["https://hasura.io/jwt/claims"].(map[string]interface{})["x-hasura-default-role"].(string) caused runtime panics and HTTP 500 crashes whenever the Hasura claims payload was not a map or was missing.
  3. JWT Algorithm Confusion Vulnerability (CWE-327 / CWE-347):
    • In src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt.go, jwt.Parse verified tokens without enforcing the HMAC signing method (*jwt.SigningMethodHMAC). Tokens using the "none" algorithm or RSA algorithm confusion were not explicitly rejected by the keyfunc callback.

2. Scope

  1. Eliminate Data Race in AuthMiddleware.go:

    • Remove var AuthData any and its mutation on incoming requests.
    • Enforce safe two-step claims extraction (claims, okClaims := data[...].(map[string]interface{})).
    • Propagate Keycloak claims to context locals when present (c.Locals("keycloak", kc)).

  2. Harden JWT Verification in Jwt.go:

    • Verify token.Method.(*jwt.SigningMethodHMAC) inside the keyfunc callback, rejecting "none" and asymmetric algorithms.

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Add src/Utils/Jwt/Jwt_test.go verifying valid HMAC tokens, invalid secrets, and rejection of "none" algorithm signatures.
    • Expand src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/AuthMiddleware_test.go to test wildcard path exclusions, missing headers, invalid tokens, valid user tokens, malformed claims panic protection, and viewer role generation.

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Valid user and viewer tokens continue to authenticate identically with identical context locals (userId, encrypt, role, exp).
    • Unauthorized status codes (401 Unauthorized) and JSON error bodies remain identical.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • var AuthData any eliminated from AuthMiddleware.go.
  • JWT verification strictly enforces *jwt.SigningMethodHMAC.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Middleware/AuthMiddleware/... ./src/Utils/Jwt/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./cmd/...).

issues.display_title: Issue #600: Redis Nil-Pointer Defense and Graceful Degradation
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Redis Nil-Pointer Defense and Graceful Degradation

  • Date: 21-10-2026
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS

1. Summary

Hardened the Redis utility package (src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go) in panorra-api-go with comprehensive nil-pointer guards and graceful degradation mechanisms:

  1. Core Visibility Guard (GetEncodedStringList):

    • Added if RedisClient == nil || key == "" check, safely returning []string{}. Prevents cascading server-wide nil-pointer crashes during Redis restarts.

  2. Graceful Cache Fallbacks:

    • ViewerSuggestionUser & SuggestionUser: Wrapped redis.Get and redis.Set in nil checks; queries database directly when Redis is offline.
    • ListBookmarksUser: Safely falls back to relational queries if Redis is offline or cache misses.
    • ReplaceUserDetails & ReplaceDeactiveUser & ReplaceBlockedPostEC: Added if Config.DB == nil and nil client guards.
    • FindKeysByPrefixV1, DeletePanoramaStatus, DeleteAllPanoramaStatus: Added nil client guards.

  3. Automated Unit Testing (src/Utils/Redis/Redis_test.go):

    • Implemented 10 unit tests verifying nil-safety across GetEncodedStringList, FindKeysByPrefixV1, DeletePanoramaStatus, DeleteAllPanoramaStatus, ReplaceUserDetails, ViewerSuggestionUser, SuggestionUser, ListBookmarksUser, GetDeactiveUser, and ReplaceBlockedPostEC.

2. Files Updated & Created

  • Updated: src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go
  • Created: src/Utils/Redis/Redis_test.go
  • Created: docs/tasks/21-10-2026/redis_nil_pointer_defense_and_graceful_degradation.md
  • Created: docs/tasks/implementations/21-10-2026/redis_nil_pointer_defense_and_graceful_degradation_impl.md

3. Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./src/Utils/Redis/...
# PASS (0 issues)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Utils/Redis/...
# PASS: 10/10 tests pass cleanly (100% OK)

  • Build Check:

    go build ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)
  • Area: Core Utils / Redis / Resilience / Stability
  • Files Affected:
    • src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go
    • src/Utils/Redis/Redis_test.go
  • Date: 21-10-2026

1. Problem & Context

In panorra-api-go, the Redis utility layer (src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go) assumed RedisClient and Config.DB were always non-nil and connected:

  1. GetEncodedStringList: Invoked directly on RedisClient.Get(...) without a nil check. Because this function is called on almost every API request by Functions.ResolveContentVisibility and ResolveUserVisibility, an uninitialized or disconnected Redis client caused an immediate runtime panic crash (nil pointer dereference) across the entire service.
  2. ViewerSuggestionUser, SuggestionUser, and ListBookmarksUser: Called redis.Get and redis.Set directly. If Redis was unavailable, requests failed catastrophically rather than falling back to database lookups (graceful degradation).
  3. ReplaceUserDetails, ReplaceDeactiveUser, ReplaceBlockedPostEC, FindKeysByPrefixV1, DeletePanoramaStatus, and DeleteAllPanoramaStatus: Lacked guards for nil redis / Config.DB, leading to panics when invoked in isolated unit tests or during service reconnection phases.

2. Scope

  1. Fortify src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go:

    • Add if RedisClient == nil || key == "" checks to GetEncodedStringList, safely returning empty slices.
    • Guard Redis read/write operations in ViewerSuggestionUser, SuggestionUser, and ListBookmarksUser, ensuring database queries execute and return results even when caching is temporarily offline.
    • Add if Config.DB == nil guards to all database-backed Redis synchronization helpers.
    • Guard FindKeysByPrefixV1, DeletePanoramaStatus, and DeleteAllPanoramaStatus against nil client pointers.

  2. Automated Unit Testing (src/Utils/Redis/Redis_test.go):

    • Create 10 comprehensive unit tests verifying that all Redis methods safely execute without panicking when RedisClient and Config.DB are nil or disconnected.

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • When Redis and Database are connected, all cache lookups, expirations, and serialization behaviors function identically.
    • When Redis is temporarily unavailable or restarting, API requests degrade gracefully by serving database data rather than crashing the server.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero nil-pointer dereferences in src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Utils/Redis/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./cmd/...).

issues.display_title: Issue #601: Eliminate Type Assertion Panics and Guard Context Locals
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Eliminate Type Assertion Panics and Guard Context Locals

  • Date: 21-10-2026
  • Status: Completed
  • Coverage: 100% PASS

1. Summary

Hardened all active non-slim action handlers in panorra-api-go against runtime type assertion panics:

  1. Strongly-Typed Database Scans:

    • In src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousComment.go and ListPreviousReplyComment.go, replaced untyped map[string]interface{} scanning with targetCommentRow and targetReplyCommentRow structs, eliminating all unchecked .(string) and .(time.Time) conversions.

  2. Safe Profile Data Formatting:

    • In src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go, implemented comma-ok type assertions for birthday (time.Time and string fallbacks), subscribe (bool), and about_me (string).

  3. Safe Context Locals Guarding Across 29 Files:

    • Standardized all c.Locals("role"), c.Locals("encrypt"), and c.Locals("userId") extractions to use val, _ := c.Locals(...).(string).

2. Files Updated & Created

  • Updated Comments: ListPreviousComment.go, ListPreviousReplyComment.go, ListComments.go, TotalBlockedComment.go, TotalBlockedLikeComment.go
  • Updated Users: ProfileUser.go, CheckPassword.go, SuggestionUserHalf.go

    • src/Action/V1/Centrifugo/TokenCentrifugo.go
  • Date: 21-10-2026

1. Problem & Context

Across active handlers in panorra-api-go, several patterns of unchecked type assertions created severe runtime panic vulnerabilities:

  1. Raw Database Scan to Map:
    • In ListPreviousComment.go and ListPreviousReplyComment.go, database results were scanned into map[string]interface{} and cast directly: 
      postId := comment["post_id"].(string)
createdAt := comment["created_at"].(time.Time)
visibility := comment["visibility"].(string)
      If PostgreSQL returned a UUID byte slice, null value, or driver type, this panicked with interface conversion: interface {} is ... not string.
  2. Unchecked Profile Date & Boolean Casting:
    • In ProfileUser.go, user["birthday"].(time.Time).Format(...), qCheckFollow[0]["subscribe"].(bool), and user["about_me"].(string) panicked whenever values were nil or string dates.
  3. Unguarded c.Locals("..."):
    • Handlers across Likes, Search, Broadcast, Bookmarks, Comments, and Users called c.Locals("role").(string) and c.Locals("encrypt").(string) without two-value checks. If locals were nil (e.g. middleware error or unauthenticated flow), requests caused server-wide panics.

2. Scope

  1. Strongly-Typed Database Scans:
    • In ListPreviousComment.go and ListPreviousReplyComment.go, define typed row structs (targetCommentRow / targetReplyCommentRow) for GORM scanning.
  2. Safe Profile Parsing:
    • In ProfileUser.go, use comma-ok type assertions for birthday, subscribe, and about_me.
  3. Guard Context Locals Across 29 Active Files:
    • Replace all unchecked c.Locals casts with safe two-value assertions (role, _ := c.Locals("role").(string)).

3. Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Zero changes to API route paths, parameters, response status codes, or JSON schemas.
    • Runtime panics on unexpected data shapes or missing context locals are eliminated.

4. Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero unchecked c.Locals assertions in active non-slim handlers.
  • Strongly-typed struct scanning applied to previous comment handlers.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./cmd/...).
